importantNotes: 'No prophecy of Scripture came about by the prophet's own interpretation' (1:20-21) — Scripture's divine origin.
'The Lord is not slow in keeping his promise — he is patient, not wanting anyone to perish' (3:9).
The progression of Christian character (1:5-7) — faith → virtue → knowledge → self-control → perseverance → godliness → brotherly kindness → love.
Peter references Paul's letters as Scripture (3:16) — early recognition of the NT canon.
Peter knows his death is near (1:14) — Jesus had predicted it (John 21:18-19).

chapters.1: God has given us everything for life and godliness; add to your faith; Peter's impending death.
chapters.2: False teachers will come — their destruction is certain; examples from Noah and Lot.
chapters.3: Scoffers will deny the Lord's return; the Day of the Lord will come; grow in grace.
